' Auto-generated Navigator Script (ServerTrack)
Const BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:5001"
Dim posX, posY, i, res, tk
Dim wpX, wpY, p1, p2, dx, dy, dist

Function Post(url, body)
    Set http = CreateObject("WinHttp.WinHttpRequest.5.1")
    http.Open "POST", url, False
    http.SetRequestHeader "Content-Type", "application/json"
    If body <> "" Then http.Send body Else http.Send
    Post = http.ResponseText
End Function

Function GetConf(resText)
    ' Extract "conf" value from JSON: "conf":0.99
    Dim cp, ce
    cp = InStr(resText, Chr(34) & "conf" & Chr(34) & ":")
    If cp > 0 Then
        cp = cp + 7 : ce = InStr(cp, resText, ",")
        If ce = 0 Then ce = InStr(cp, resText, "}")
        If ce > 0 Then GetConf = CDbl(Mid(resText, cp, ce - cp))
    End If
End Function

' 1. Plan
res = Post(BASE & "/api/plan", "{""start"":[{SX},{SY}],""goal"":[{GX},{GY}]}")
TracePrint "Plan done"

posX = {SX} : posY = {SY}
For i = 1 To 300
    ' 2. ServerTrack: phase-correlation position correction
    tk = Post(BASE & "/api/track_frame", "{""x"":" & posX & ",""y"":" & posY & "}")
    If GetConf(tk) > 0.5 Then
        p1 = InStr(tk, Chr(34) & "pos" & Chr(34) & ":[")
        If p1 > 0 Then
            p1 = p1 + 7 : p2 = InStr(p1, tk, ",")
            posX = CLng(Mid(tk, p1, p2 - p1))
            p1 = p2 + 1 : p2 = InStr(p1, tk, "]")
            If p2 > 0 Then posY = CLng(Mid(tk, p1, p2 - p1))
        End If
    End If

    ' 3. Step: get direction from corrected position
    res = Post(BASE & "/api/step", "{""x"":" & posX & ",""y"":" & posY & "}")
    If InStr(res, Chr(34) & "arrived" & Chr(34) & ":true") > 0 Then
        TracePrint "Arrived! (" & posX & "," & posY & ")" : Exit For
    End If

    ' 4. Move toward waypoint
    p1 = InStr(res, Chr(34) & "waypoint" & Chr(34) & ":[")
    If p1 > 0 Then
        p1 = p1 + 12 : p2 = InStr(p1, res, ",")
        If p2 > 0 Then
            wpX = CLng(Mid(res, p1, p2 - p1))
            p1 = p2 + 1 : p2 = InStr(p1, res, "]")
            wpY = CLng(Mid(res, p1, p2 - p1))
            dx = wpX - posX : dy = wpY - posY
            dist = Sqr(dx*dx + dy*dy)
            If dist > 1 Then
                posX = posX + CLng(dx / dist * {SPD})
                posY = posY + CLng(dy / dist * {SPD})
            End If
        End If
    End If

    ' 5. Report
    Post BASE & "/api/report", "{""x"":" & posX & ",""y"":" & posY & "}"
    If i Mod 10 = 0 Then
        TracePrint "Step" & i & ": (" & posX & "," & posY & ")"
    End If
    Delay {DLY}
Next
TracePrint "Done!"
